_meta.what: Russian Synodal (printed) numbering vs English (KJV/BSB) numbering, for rst.json in this pack.
_meta.keyRule: All files in data/text/ use 9-digit ids BBBCCCVVV in English numbering. rst.json is ALREADY renumbered to it by Words, so rst text is looked up by the English id directly. Use this table only to show or parse a Russian (Synodal) reference.
_meta.enToRu: English id -> Synodal 'chapter:verse' list for the same book; omitted when identical; [] = no Synodal verse.
_meta.ruToEn: Synodal id (same 9-digit form, Synodal numbers) -> English id; omitted when identical.
_meta.joined: English ids that are empty in rst.json because the Synodal joins them to the verse before; value = id holding the text.
_meta.lostInWords: Synodal verses missing from Words' rst.json: the first half of two-verse Psalm superscriptions, dropped by Words' tools/import_rst.py (titles dict keeps only the last title verse). Report to Words; not patched here.
_meta.bsbOmits: English ids the KJV numbers but bsb-yhwh.json has no verse for.
_meta.ruChapterVerses: Synodal verse count per chapter, per book (Protestant canon form, as eBible's russyn).
